homePage.intro: Find movies and TV shows, with posters, genres and ratings from TMDB.

settings.ownKeyOptional: The app already has access to TMDB, so this is optional. A key of your own is used instead of the app's, which keeps the search working if the app's access ever stops.
settings.ownKeyRequired: This copy of the app was built without access to TMDB. Save a key of your own to be able to search.
settings.getKey: Get a key on the TMDB website
settings.invalidKey: This does not look like a TMDB key.
settings.keyNotPersisted: The key could not be saved to disk, so it is kept only until the app closes.
settings.keyNotEncrypted: This system has no keyring, so the key is saved without encryption.

search.error: The search failed. Check your connection and try again.
search.errorNoAccess: This copy of the app has no access to TMDB. Save a key of your own in the settings.
search.errorAppRefused: TMDB refused the app's access. Update the app, or use a key of your own.
search.errorOwnKeyRefused: TMDB refused your key. Check it or remove it in the settings.
